evals.name: shell-exec-diagnostic
evals.prompt: Using mcp-shell, run a non-interactive shell command to check Python version, disk space, and search for TODO comments in the workspace.
evals.expected_output: Calls shell_exec with a concise, non-interactive command producing bounded output within max_execution_time and max_output_size.
assertions: Uses shell_exec when unrestricted mode is active
Keeps command non-interactive and bounded so it does not exceed max_output_size or max_execution_time
Does not attempt base64=true for plain UTF-8 text output

evals.name: binary-output-base64
evals.prompt: Use mcp-shell to inspect the first 64 raw bytes of a binary file without corrupting UTF-8 output.
evals.expected_output: Calls shell_exec with base64=true (or formats output as hex/base64 cleanly) to handle binary stdout safely.
assertions: Accounts for binary output safety via base64=true on shell_exec or hex formatting

evals.name: secure-mode-config-nuance
evals.prompt: Explain what happens if MCP_SHELL_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1 is set while pointing MCP_SHELL_SEC_CONFIG_FILE at a YAML file with security.enabled: true, and which limits still apply in shell_exec mode.
evals.expected_output: Explains that YAML security.enabled: true overrides MCP_SHELL_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1 back to secure mode, and notes that even when enabled: false + MCP_SHELL_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1 are active, CommandExecutor still enforces max_execution_time, max_output_size, working_directory, and run_as_user.
assertions: States YAML enabled: true overrides MCP_SHELL_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1
Lists max_execution_time, max_output_size, working_directory, and run_as_user as still enforced in shell_exec mode
Notes max_output_size caps stdout and stderr independently and cancels on overflow
